title: Sparse Fourier polynomial value
statement: For a positive integer $n$, a sparse Fourier hypothesis consists of a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ with a rational coefficient assigned to each member. At an input $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, its value is the sum over those subsets of the coefficient times the product of the coordinates of $x$ indexed by that subset.
hypotheses_covered: a sparse Fourier hypothesis on $n$ Boolean coordinates
